headline: LargestofRocks Drops a 187 and Stroud Boys Drop Their Pants
subhead: Week 6 was a beatdown buffet — six wins, six different flavors of pain, and one bench so loaded it could've won the matchup by itself.
matchOfTheWeek: OnlyFants squeaked past The Olave Garden 148.96 to 144.72, a 4-point heart attack that probably aged Patrickreegs about six years. Meanwhile Jets' Juniors edged 226 Alpha by 2.18 — a game szara lost from the bench, where DeMario Douglas (21.2) and Romeo Doubs (19.9) sat watching like it was a Netflix special. That's 41 points of regret on the pine, Sam. Forty. One.
powerRankingsShakeup: LargestofRocks just put up a 187 and screamed 'come get me.' MassiveCocks and Stroud Boys are both speed-running the basement — combined 190 points between them, which is three points fewer than LargestofRocks alone.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage. LargestofRocks hung 187.96 on Stroud Boys, who responded with a limp 103.24 and a apology email. Chris Godwin went full nuclear with 35.5, the lineup hit 96% efficiency, and bjewett13 is currently Googling 'how to fake an injury for the rest of the season.' An 84-point loss isn't a matchup, it's a hostage situation.

Over in the swamp of sadness, MassiveCocks scored 87.06 — the lowest of the week — while leaving FIFTY-FOUR points on the bench. Evan Engram dropped 23.2 in street clothes (your clothes). 7BigPapi7, the optimal lineup was 141.16. You didn't lose to T swift's Baddies, you lost to your own start/sit button. Tnicolle just had to show up and collect.

Put an AR to My Head got AR'd by The Good Ladds 129-90, and the kicker? Tyrone Tracy posted 22.7 on Mig56's bench. The Good Ladds won by 38 with a starter playing JV. Cole Kmet went for 26.5 at TE — Kyle, you got cooked by a Bears tight end. Read that sentence again.

Hot Cocks lit up Bo Nix Celli 172.88-140.38 in the week's biggest shootout. Baker Mayfield (28.9), Mixon (27.2), and Kittle (25.3) — BigD's lineup was a buffet. Caleb Williams hung 29.64 in a losing effort, and Bijan added 25.5, which means nickcelli scored 140 and STILL got smoked. Brutal.

Jets' Juniors got 26.6 from Jordan Love and 25.2 from Derrick Henry and still only beat 226 Alpha by two. mattwunder, take the W and don't ask questions. And shoutout to The Good Ladds and 226 Alpha for swapping Etienne and Pittman mid-week — one of you's gonna look like a genius and one of you's gonna get this paragraph dedicated to you in November.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Caleb dropped 29 and Bijan dropped 25 and nickcelli still got run off the field by 32 — sometimes the universe just hates you.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Won by 2.18 against a guy who benched 41 points of WRs — accept the W, log off, don't make eye contact.
